justifications.fit: the portfolio store at reckon/crew/plan_review.py:3322 mirrors the sibling code-review store (code_review_path, :2700) under a distinct portfolio prefix, and no added symbol carries a plan, sprint or version label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/plan_review.py:3061 filters to plans whose status is not shipped and :3137 emits one DISPOSITION figure line per plan while :2888 refuses an omission by name, matching the node's goal.
justifications.reuse: every figure is read from the owner that already holds it — implementable_sections (reckon/roadmap.py:109), derived_plan_age (reckon/doccheck.py:290) and SHIPPED_PLAN_STATUSES (reckon/doccheck.py:176) — and the new parser and store extend plan_review.py rather than forking one.
justifications.scope_discipline: all five files in git diff --stat 776a5d59..058bc96c lie inside the manifest's declared write paths, with no edit outside them.
